first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An adult man wearing a nearly black suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie, with short brownish-gray hair that is lighter at the side of the head.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: The grayish-brown to light-gray wall surfaces around the stairs and window opening, with rough block surfaces and joints exposed in places.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A dark architectural structure comprising wooden stair treads, thick posts, crossbeams, diagonal members, and handrails.

entities.name: Reddish-brown plane at the far end
entities.identification: A reddish-brown plane deep within the Central vertical shaft opening, with rectangular divisions and patches of varying lightness.

entities.name: Two hands at the bottom edge
entities.identification: Two bare hands, separated from each other, gripping the same round rod at the bottom edge of the image, with the lower wrists cropped out.

entities.name: Central vertical shaft opening
entities.identification: The central dark space extending downward between the layered wooden stairs and crossbeams.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: The opening in the wall behind Person A that leads outdoors, with a thick light-gray window edge and a darker sill.

entities.name: Foreground horizontal round rod
entities.identification: The slender brown round rod spanning the lower edge of the image in frames 0 through 25 and gripped by the Two hands at the bottom edge.

entities.name: Green vegetation outside the window
entities.identification: The distant green ground areas and darker clustered tree canopies outside the window.

entities.name: Group of light-colored components outside the window
entities.identification: Grouped light grayish-white block-like components distributed among the green areas outside the window, with outlines of varying heights.
